approved_v2_behavior: The dstack executable provides generated help and version and rejects unsupported input nonzero.
notes: V1 direct execution remains characterized unchanged.

approved_v2_behavior: Stacks are selected only with --stack or -s, session context, or exact cwd; operands are never guessed as stacks.
notes: Compatibility wrappers may retain bounded v1 parsing.

approved_v2_behavior: Explicit --stack/-s takes precedence over session context, then exact cwd, then error.
notes: No implicit parent traversal.

approved_v2_behavior: Docker and command passthrough use exact argv vectors after the command-specific -- boundary.
notes: Never reconstruct or evaluate a shell command string.

approved_v2_behavior: Docker failures propagate meaningful failure status.
notes: Exact DStack-owned status codes remain deferred.

approved_v2_behavior: Diagnostics use stderr; command data and Docker stdout use stdout; Docker stderr remains stderr.
notes: V1 stdout diagnostics remain characterized.

approved_v2_behavior: Invalid active session context is a nonzero error and never falls through to another project.
notes: Unset is explicit.

approved_v2_behavior: Compose resolution errors are typed, nonzero, and cannot become file argv.
notes: Explicit noninteractive file selection is required when ambiguous.

approved_v2_behavior: Invalid Compose selection is a typed nonzero error and Docker is not invoked.
notes: Not implemented before Compose resolution.

approved_v2_behavior: Missing Compose files produce a nonzero resolution error before Docker.
notes: Not implemented before Compose resolution.

approved_v2_behavior: Compose files are selected with repeatable --file or --all-files, not positional guessing.
notes: Compatibility parsing is bounded.

approved_v2_behavior: Typed commands have explicit service operands and position-independent DStack options where unambiguous.
notes: Raw compose argv begins at the compose passthrough boundary.

approved_v2_behavior: Use recreate --volumes; down failure stops the workflow before typed up.

approved_v2_behavior: Registry keys use exact structured lookup rather than regular expressions.
